zh.title: 新增 Nace.AI Drex provider
zh.description: 可选择 drex-v1.5、drex-v2.0 或 drex-max；Max 支持图片输入，设置页默认选用 drex-v2.0。

zh.title: Clef-omni 支持音频和视频
zh.description: Cloudflare Clef-omni 现在可接收音频与视频附件；其他 Clef 模型仍支持图片。

zh.title: 修复 Drex 概率舍入后的结果校验
zh.description: Drex 概率经四位小数舍入后略偏离 1 时，只要仍在舍入误差范围内，现在也能正常返回结果。

en.title: Add the Nace.AI Drex provider
en.description: Choose drex-v1.5, drex-v2.0, or drex-max. Max accepts images, and provider settings default to drex-v2.0.

en.title: Clef-omni accepts audio and video
en.description: Cloudflare Clef-omni can now receive audio and video attachments; the other Clef models continue to support images.

en.title: Accept Drex probabilities rounded to four decimal places
en.description: Drex results now pass validation when rounded probabilities differ slightly from 1 but remain within the rounding-error bound.

zh.title: 超时改为按 provider 配置
zh.description: 请求仍可逐次覆盖超时；provider 设置页现在各自控制默认超时。服务级 timeoutMs 已移除，旧服务配置中的残留值会被忽略。

zh.title: 第三方 provider 契约更新
zh.description: 自定义 provider 需实现 timeoutMs()，并显式声明问题数量上限及每种支持附件的数量、字节上限。

zh.title: 统一附件资源保护与 provider 一致性检查
zh.description: 公共层为附件设置安全上限，并以一致性套件核对内置模型的能力、原语、附件和实际响应。

en.title: Configure timeouts per provider
en.description: Calls can still override timeouts individually; provider settings now control each provider's default. Service-level timeoutMs was removed, and residual values in old service configuration are ignored.

en.title: Update custom provider contracts
en.description: Custom providers must implement timeoutMs() and explicitly declare question limits and count/byte limits for each supported attachment type.

en.title: Bound shared attachment resources and verify provider conformance
en.description: The shared layer now enforces attachment safety ceilings, and a conformance suite checks built-in model capabilities, primitives, attachments, and real response normalization.
